Gold and Silver Prices See Volatility Amid Global Factors

Gold and silver prices experienced declines and are expected to remain volatile. Factors influencing the market include US-Iran negotiations, crude oil trends, and global economic data. Expectations of US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes have also strengthened the dollar, impacting precious metal values.
